channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Andre Iguodala | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Andre Iguodala from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Andre Iguodala, Kevin Durant, Andrew Bogut, Klay Thompson
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Who are your top three defensive teammates of all time? Andrew Bogut number one, Klay Thompson number two. Klay Thompson, ball hawk. And I'd say number three, number three, my favorite defensive teammate of all time, or not favorite, but top three. Kevin Durant was elite defensively here. Elite. Andre Iguodala. Andre Iguodala made the game really easy. Got to go with Andre. It has to be Andre.”

Draymond Green on Andre Iguodala, Kevin Durant, Andrew Bogut, Klay Thompson, Jun 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Andre Iguodala, Paul George, Klay Thompson, Draymond Green
item.description:
Beverley revealed he thinks Golden State would have won more than four titles if Paul George replaced Thompson.

“If you put Paul George in that role playing as Klay Thompson, playing with [Steph Curry, Draymond Green, Andre Iguodala] at a point -- obviously we know Paul George a couple years ago, was in the MVP race,”

Patrick Beverley on Andre Iguodala, Paul George, Klay Thompson, Draymond Green, Aug 25, 2025. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, Draymond Green
item.description:
“He’s such a unique personality within that, and I think along with Steph and Draymond and Andre [Iguodala], I think those are the four guys on the Mount Rushmore of the Warriors dynasty.”

Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, Draymond Green, Jul 2, 2024. Source: The Ringer.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
“Our franchise has been like that since I’ve been here. Andre Iguodala made the same sacrifice. He came around and got Finals MVP. I’m not saying I’m going to do that this season. I’m still playing 25-30 minutes a night, and especially 13 years in and after the injuries I overcame, it’s still an incredible accomplishment and still being a heck of a player out there. I’m scoring at all three levels, playing defense, and having fun.”

Klay Thompson on Andre Iguodala, Mar 8, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Draymond Green on Andre Iguodala, Shaun Livingston, Kevon Looney
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Kevon (Looney) has become like an Andre Iguodala, Shaun Livingston, a calming force.”

Draymond Green on Andre Iguodala, Shaun Livingston, Kevon Looney, Apr 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
“We don't win the Finals unless Andre [Iguodala] plays that way he did and that adjustment working and him giving us such a huge boost throughout the whole series.”

Stephen Curry on Andre Iguodala, Dec 1, 2022. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Andre Iguodala, Jordan Poole
item.description:
“Andre [Iguodala] addressed it yesterday with his tweet, and we can kind of leave it at that. [Poole] has been great, there’s nothing that warranted the situation yesterday, to make that clear. But it’s also something that, I feel like, will not derail our season and what we’re trying to do.”

Stephen Curry on Andre Iguodala, Jordan Poole, Oct 6, 2022. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
Mark Haynes:Steve Kerr on the gameplan for Andre Iguodala this season:

“I think it'll be similar to last year. When he is right physically and able to play, then he'll be playing. He can still play. He showed that last year.”

Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, Sep 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
Madeline Kenney:Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala situation:

“I'm just hopeful. Beyond that I really don't know what Andre is going to do.”

Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, Sep 22, 2022. Source: Twitter @madkenney.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
95.7 The Game:More Kerr on Andre Iguodala:

“He's still good enough to win games. He proved that last year. He also proved to be an irreplaceable leader in that locker room.”

Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, Sep 9, 2022. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
95.7 The Game:Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala's retirement decision:

“We'll touch base in the next couple days. Bob and I are giving him the space to make whatever decision he wants. We'll support him either way, but we hope he comes back.”

Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, Sep 9, 2022. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Draymond Green on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
“I didn’t think it would be possible as an NBA Finals MVP [which Iguodala won in 2015] that we probably felt your impact this year more than any year that you were competing and playing and dominating and clamping and settling our offense down and getting us into the position,”

Draymond Green on Andre Iguodala, Jun 18, 2022. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, Ja Morant
item.description:
Steve Kerr on how will Warriors will guard Ja Morant without GPII:

“Hopefully we get Andre Iguodala back for Game 3. We’ll see how Andre (Iguodala) fares over the next few days. If not, we’ll have to mix and match. We’ll have time to figure it out.”

Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, Ja Morant, May 4, 2022. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Klay Thompson:

“I played angry. I played angry. … Andre (Iguodala) came up to me at the end of the game and said, 'Keep your composure.'”

Klay Thompson on Andre Iguodala, May 1, 2022. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
Mark Haynes:Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala's ability to strip the ball from players:

“Part of Andre's brilliance is this amazing combination of length, athleticism, and brains. It's not just that he's so bouncy and long. It's just the fact that he understands when to reach in.”

Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, Dec 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.

item.title: Rick Welts on Andre Iguodala, Stephen Curry
item.description:
Diamond Leung:Rick Welts on the most data-driven Warriors player:

“We traded him last year, but I would say Andre Iguodala probably would have been at the top of that list. Unbelievable student of the game. But I think Curry's right behind.”

Rick Welts on Andre Iguodala, Stephen Curry, Nov 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @diamond83.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr:

“There were a lot of people in this building that enjoyed the Andre (Iguodala) show last night. That was incredible.”

Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, Sep 28, 2020. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: LeBron James on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:LeBron on MIA trading for @Andre Iguodala:

“I saw it and I was like, 'OK.' I think it makes them a better team because of his championship DNA, you add that to that championship culture down there. So it helps them right away ... I know that 'Dre is happy to be suiting it back up”

LeBron James on Andre Iguodala, Feb 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Joe Lacob on Andre Iguodala, Kevin Durant
item.description:
When asked about Iguodala’s No. 9, Lacob echoed a similar sentiment.

“We always wanna be gracious. I’ve said all along, he and any player like Kevin Durant, Andre Iguodala, whoever it is, a free agent, it's their choice. They earned it,”

Joe Lacob on Andre Iguodala, Kevin Durant, Aug 28, 2019. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, Kevin Durant
item.description:
Steve Kerr on the center position and Andre Iguodala with Kevin Durant back:

“I'm not going to sit back here and tell you what I'm going to do.”

Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, Kevin Durant, Jun 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Harden, Andre Iguodala
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Kerr on Iguodala:

“He's one of the best defenders in the league. I think he understands James Harden as well as anybody.... We need him.”

Steve Kerr on James Harden, Andre Iguodala, Apr 30, 2019. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala:

“I think he can play beyond this contract if he really wants. He may not want to. He may want to go golf, but he can if he wants.”

Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, Apr 20, 2019. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
“Andre Iguodala used to ask me what was on my head all the time, but he’s an old dude,”

Jrue Holiday on Andre Iguodala, Apr 13, 2019. Source: GQ.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, Shaun Livingston
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on the health of Iguodala and Livingston:

“I think they're fine. If this were a playoff game, Andre would play. ... Same with Shaun. Shaun just knocked knees with somebody the other night. ... I feel really comfortable with where they are health-wise.”

Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, Shaun Livingston, Apr 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala's hamstring tightness:

“Yeah, it flared up at the very end, when we took him out mid-fourth-quarter.”

Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, Feb 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala:

“Day-to-day. Each day he's getting a little better. Still doubtful for tomorrow. Making some strides.”

Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, Jun 2, 2018. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Andre Iguodala, Kevin Durant, Klay Thompson, Draymond Green
item.description:
If this is how Houston plans on taking down the defending champs, with the ball-pounding style so prevalent in Game 1 that it led to more than twice the isolation plays than the Rockets typically average (45, compared to 22) and more in one game than any team in the past five seasons, then Curry…

“If I was the opposite coach and saw Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson, Kevin Durant, Andre Iguodala and Draymond Green, I’m most likely going to (go after) me – especially for a team that relies on iso situations like they do,”

Stephen Curry on Andre Iguodala, Kevin Durant, Klay Thompson, Draymond Green, May 16, 2018. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
D'Antoni on how close Rockets came to getting Iguodala:

“He's one of the better players in the league, always has been. We were trying to get into that mode where we could be a better defensive team... It was a no-brainer to try.”

Mike D'Antoni on Andre Iguodala, May 14, 2018. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
Kerr on keeping Andre Iguodala:

“It never seemed like it was a serious deal because we knew the restrictions on what Houston could offer. We were offering twice as much. That usually does the trick.”

Steve Kerr on Andre Iguodala, May 14, 2018. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Brandon Ingram on Andre Iguodala
item.description:
“Well, the NBA veterans that I've been around, they always try to help. Even guys from other teams. When I played with the USA Select Team, all those guys were giving me advice. Even guys playing pickup coming to the Lakers facility. (Including) Andre Iguodala,”

Brandon Ingram on Andre Iguodala, Sep 19, 2016. Source: CBSSports.com.
